A nickname, a score line and a ranking screen

Build 12 added a nickname, a score line on the results screen and a ranking screen inside the app.

In short: Claimball build 12 added a nickname you can set from the menu, a score line on the results screen and a ranking screen inside the app. The score is worked out from how the match went, and your first Daily Challenge attempt of the day is the one that counts. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android.

Build 12, a TestFlight internal test build, added a bit of identity and bragging rights. It is not released to the public yet.

A nickname

You can set your own nickname from the menu. It is just a name to show on your ranking line.

A score on every result

The results screen now has a score line, so a match ends with a number as well as a win or a loss.

A ranking screen

The menu has a ranking screen inside the app, so you can see how your scores stack up.

Fair by design

The score is worked out from how the match went, and your first Daily Challenge attempt of the day is the one that counts, which fits the one-try-a-day rule.

Still being tested

We are still checking how these screens behave on real phones.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

How do I set a nickname?

You can set your own nickname from the menu. It is just a name to show on your ranking line.

What is new on the results screen?

The results screen now has a score line, so a match ends with a number as well as a win or a loss.

How is the ranking fair?

The score is worked out from how the match went, and your first Daily Challenge attempt of the day is the one that counts, which fits the one-try-a-day rule. We are still checking how these screens behave on real phones.

Is Claimball released yet?

Not yet. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android, and there is no release date yet.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
